toggle-button.$description: ToggleButton's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--toggle-button-<name>) on the page, a container or one toggle, and everything inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text-pressed.$description: Text and icon while pressed (4.5:1 on bg-pressed).

border-pressed.$description: The outline variant's border while pressed (3:1 on surface).

bg-pressed-held.$description: The background of an on toggle while held down, one step past bg-pressed.

text-pressed-held.$description: Text and icon of an on toggle while held down (4.5:1 on bg-pressed-held).

bg-pressed-disabled.$description: The background while on and disabled.

text-pressed-disabled.$description: Text and icon while on and disabled (3.4:1 and up on bg-pressed-disabled, as on a disabled Button).

border-pressed-disabled.$description: The outline variant's border while on and disabled (3:1 on surface).
